passages.note: House roll call 70 on HJR 3 (2014) 3rd reading; Heaton voted Yea.
Indiana House bill page lists Heaton as a co-author of HJR 3 (2014).
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Timothy Wesco, Rep. Wes Culver, Rep. Rhonda Rhoads, Rep. Robert Heaton, Rep. Don Lehe, Rep. Matthew Lehman, Rep. Randall Frye.

passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: HJR 3 (2014) operative text restricts valid/recognized marriage to one man and one woman.

rows.reasoning: Heaton co-authored HJR 3 (2014) and voted Yea on its House passage (Roll Call 70, Yea 57–Nay 40). The resolution's operative text, "Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana," matches the rung that makes same-sex marriage illegal and defines marriage as only between one man and one woman.
